text_blocks.snippet: While the terms "therapist" and "psychotherapist" are often used interchangeably, psychotherapist is a more specific term, referring to a therapist who specializes in talk therapy to address psychological and emotional issues, while "therapist" can refer to professionals in a broader range of fields, including physical and occupational therapy.
snippet_highlighted_words: psychotherapist is a more specific term, referring to a therapist who specializes in talk therapy to address psychological and emotional issues, while "therapist" can refer to professionals in a broader range of fields, including physical and occupational therapy

list.snippet: A general term for a professional who provides treatment for a condition to improve it, whether physical or mental.
Can encompass a wide range of specialties, including physical therapy, occupational therapy, and mental health counseling.
May or may not have extensive training in psychotherapy.
Can be a counselor, social worker, psychologist, or psychiatrist.
A more specific term referring to a therapist who specializes in talk therapy to address psychological and emotional issues.
Often has extensive training and experience in fields like social work, mental health counseling, or marriage and family therapy, according to MedicineNet.
Focuses on understanding the root causes of distress and developing strategies to improve emotional and psychological well-being, says Grow Therapy.
May utilize various therapeutic modalities like Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), psychoanalysis, or humanistic therapy, notes Choosing Therapy.

list.title: Scope:
list.snippet: "Therapist" is a broader term, while "psychotherapist" is more specialized within mental health.

list.title: Training:
list.snippet: While both require training, psychotherapists often have more specialized training in psychotherapy techniques.

list.title: Focus:
list.snippet: "Psychotherapist" often implies a deeper exploration of psychological and emotional issues, while "therapist" can refer to more general treatment of various conditions.

text_blocks.snippet: A physical therapist is a type of therapist, but they are not a psychotherapist. A clinical psychologist who specializes in talk therapy to address anxiety is both a therapist and a psychotherapist.
